label: Product film
description: A controlled reveal that preserves shape, material, function and brand evidence.
principles: Preserve product geometry and supplied marks; do not invent text, features or claims.
Prioritize silhouette, tactile material response and readable cause and effect over decorative motion.
Use motivated lighting and camera movement consistent with the authored direction.
Finish on the specified product state without adding promotional copy or unsupported UI.
evidence_status: Original direction heuristics; visual effectiveness requires provider renders and human evaluation, not guaranteed by unit tests.
priority: approved shot timing and reference roles
